lines: Then he purified fit having known self in own doctrine; practice of that spoken thing for enjoyment for liberation and cultivates.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sa saṃskṛtaṃ yogyaṃ jñātvātmānaṃ svaśāsane taduktavastvanuṣṭhānaṃ bhuktyai muktyai ca sevate
